name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo 3: Seiryuu Densetsu Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 金田一少年の事件簿 3:青龍伝説殺人事件
source:
In this case Kindaichi & Miyuki go to an island and they are in the Seiryu Hotel and when they are in the reception a murdered happened in the elevator, Kindaichi & Mijuri helped police inspector Kenmochi solving the case. The game featured 4 different cases in the Seiryu Hotel.

[from [url=http://psxdata.snesorama.us/games/J/K/SLPS-02223.html]Playstation DataCenter[/url]]
translation:
本案中，金田一与美雪来到一座岛屿，入住青龙酒店。他们在前台时，电梯内发生了一起谋杀案。金田一和美雪协助剑持警部调查真相。游戏共收录四起发生在青龙酒店的案件。

[摘自[url=http://psxdata.snesorama.us/games/J/K/SLPS-02223.html]Playstation DataCenter[/url]]
